1.0.2: Add 'groups:read' to the listChannels component to fix 'missing_scope' error.
2.2.3: Add new components: UpdateMessage, DeleteMessage, UploadFileToChannel, UploadFileToUser, DeleteFile and GetFileMetadata.
2.4.1: Add new components: SendDirectMessage and ListUsers.
Add new components: AddReaction, DeleteReaction, ListReactions and GetMessageReactions.
2.4.2: Fixed an issue with NewUser trigger throwing error when triggered.
3.1.0: (breaking change) SendChannelMessage, SendPrivateChannelMessage: Channel field now accepts values from other components.
SendChannelMessage, SendPrivateChannelMessage: Migration to v3 - The Channel field needs to be filled again.
(breaking change) New Channel Message trigger: added scope groups:read. Will require removal of account from `connected accounts` and re-authentication of Slack account.

(breaking change) New User trigger now uses webhooks. The old version is now called 'NewUser - Legacy' and will be deprecated. It requiers additional configuration in your Slack account, please see the documentation.
Existing triggers NewChannelMessage and NewPrivateChannelMessage are now deprecated.
Updated labels to make them better to read in some components.
3.2.0: NewChannelMessageRT: added more output variables such as: channel, channel_type, team, event_ts, blocks, bot_profile.
4.1.3: (breaking change) Added payload authentication for triggers. Will require setting `signingSecret` in the connector configuration.
Added options to SendChannelMessage and SendPrivateChannelMessage to send messages as a bot user.
Fixed and issue when NewChannelMessageRT trigger did not register messages containing some special UTF characters.
4.1.5: Improve `botToken` handling in SendChannelMessage and SendPrivateChannelMessage components when using the default configuration.
`signingSecret` existence is now checked only when not using the default configuration.
4.2.0: Added 'Thread message ID' to SendChannelMessage and SendPrivateChannelMessage components.
5.0.1: Fixed an issue with the `botToken` not being set correctly in the auth profile info. Requires re-authentication of the following components: SendChannelMessage, SendPrivateChannelMessage.
5.0.2: Fixed an issue with invalid user selection in UploadFileToUser and SendDirectMessage components.
5.1.3: Added new component: `Request Approval` - Slack Task allows human approval inside workflows, with Slack user selection.
Added new component: `Find Request Approvals` - List and filter Slack Workflow Approvals. Only available with ACL enabled for private components.
5.1.4: Added output examples to component schemas.
changelog.5.2.0: ListChannels: make component public; add output port schema for channels.
5.3.0: Added test() (Flow Test Mode) to all triggers: NewChannelMessage, NewPrivateChannelMessage, NewChannelMessageRT, NewUser, NewUserWebhook — emit one realistic item via a read-only call, same shape as production output.
5.4.0: Added MakeApiCall component for performing arbitrary authorized API calls to the Slack API.
5.4.1: Added missing output examples to SendDirectMessage.
5.4.2: NewChannelMessageRT: the channel picker is now a typeahead text field, so a value can still be entered when the list fails to load; added missing output examples.
5.4.3: Fixed output fields that never resolved: UploadFileToUser, UploadFileToChannel and GetFileMetadata expose mimetype / filetype (were mimeType / fileType), NewUser and NewUserWebhook expose updated (was update), UpdateMessage exposes message.user (was user); CreateChannel and CreatePrivateChannel no longer declare members, which Slack does not return; RequestApproval's created port now carries id like its other ports. Required-input checks and typeahead channel pickers; output examples.
5.5.1: ListChannels, ListUsers, ListReactions: the Limit input is gone; all pages are fetched internally. Array output now also carries count.
FindRequestApprovals: Limit input removed (up to 1000 approvals per call), new notFound port for an empty result.
ListChannels, ListUsers, ListReactions, FindRequestApprovals: output contract exported as ITEM_SCHEMA with examples; variable picker works without a connected account.
GetMessageReactions: static output schema (was borrowed from ListReactions), full reaction details.
DeleteFile, DeleteMessage, DeleteReaction: return an empty object on success.
SendChannelMessage, SendPrivateChannelMessage: thread inputs renamed to threadTs and replyBroadcast (flows saved with the old names keep working); required inputs are validated.
Channel, user, requester and approver pickers are typeahead text fields so a value can still be entered when the list fails to load.
Required-input validation in AddReaction, DeleteReaction, DeleteMessage, DeleteFile, GetMessageReactions and ListReactions.
Fixed the OAuth consent failing with "Invalid permissions requested" when a component needs channels:write (CreateChannel): the bot scope now asks for channels:manage instead.

SendChannelMessage, SendPrivateChannelMessage: output schema declares subtype, username, bot_id, app_id and team; ts, type, text and bot_id are marked required, user and team are optional because Slack omits them for messages sent as bot (subtype bot_message).
5.5.2: RequestApproval: a task whose flow or component no longer exists (webhook answers 404/410) is removed instead of being resubmitted every 10 minutes forever.

RequestApproval: other failed webhook deliveries (e.g. a stopped flow) are retried with an exponential backoff, at most 6 hours apart (configurable via failedWebhooksBackoffBaseMs and failedWebhooksBackoffMaxMs), so the decision is delivered once the flow runs again.
RequestApproval: a resubmitted webhook delivers the original decision (approved / rejected / due) instead of pending; the resubmit job reports delivered, failed and removed tasks correctly.
RequestApproval: the cleanup of tasks older than 60 days never removed anything (it filtered by a property the tasks do not have); it works now.
